t1: For twenty-five years, NASA satellites have watched our wildfires.
t2: But in 2012, the satellite changed, and the record broke.
t3: Firely stitches MODIS and VIIRS into one honest series.
t4: Explore any place on the web, or carry it in your pocket. See what's normal, what's not, and what's coming.
t5: Ask Gotita. Get an alert when your area runs hot.
t6: Firely. Twenty-five years of fire. One series.
